frames.scope: URDF, MJCF and USD share these names; details in urdf_frames

parameter_notes.joint_limits: Opening limit 28.92 degrees (0.5047492196767601 rad). Both hinge axes +X in the base frame; the -Y taccap_right_finger_joint drives (positive opens) and taccap_left_finger_joint mimics with multiplier -1.
parameter_notes.base_inertia: 0.153 kg body; motor (0.299 kg) and physical camera (0.018 kg) have separate fixed links. Mass, COM and inertia tensors copied from the locked upstream URDF.
parameter_notes.finger_inertia: 0.140 kg per finger; upstream COM-centred inertia tensors retained without mass rescaling.
parameter_notes.effort: 1.1 Nm: maximum output torque of the finger motor (RobStride EL05), which the hardware limits to 1.1 Nm for continuous stall. The same value is the MJCF actuator forcerange and the USD drive maxForce.
parameter_notes.collision_meshes: Simplified upstream collision meshes; camera collision uses the visual camera mesh.
parameter_notes.physical_provenance: Upstream measured integer masses with SW COM-centred moments; inertia is not rescaled to weighed mass. Corrected camera COM retained; measurement finger angle 0.05774812915895569 rad differs from q=0.

drive.status: MuJoCo position gains converted per-radian to per-degree

urdf_frames.base_definition: Gripper mounting face centre (body/adapter mating face) in both variants; carries the body mesh and 0.153 kg body inertial. Motor and physical camera have separate fixed links.
urdf_frames.axes: +Z tool axis (native CAD +X), +Y toward the left finger (native +Y), +X toward the off-axis fingers (native -Z); taccap_eef_link has the same axes

native_cad_placement.note: Native placement for body_link.STL, motor_link.STL and camera_link.STL; flange_link.STL uses rotation only. Finger meshes use the upstream closed-pose correction; see vendor/taccap_slave/source/provenance/finger_reference.json.

with_mount.root_origin: Asm_link robot-side face centre (attaches to the arm flange)

urdf_frames.mount_interface: Asm_link: 4 x 6.5 mm through holes on 50 mm PCD at 45 deg, 26 mm centre bore; set the clocking about +Z per installation
urdf_frames.eef_pose_policy: Inherited massless EEF frame retained. New mesh distal-face centre differs by 0.075 mm along +X at q=0; master/slave feature correspondence is checked within 0.1 mm.
urdf_frames.finger_frames: Finger link frames share base axes (joint origin rpy 0, hinge axis +X). Finger mesh placements retain the upstream +/-0.05774812915895569 rad hinge-axis correction relative to native 0,-pi/2,0 placement; this converts the measurement pose to closed q=0.

camera.source: Wrist camera point on the dome-window axis, from the taccap_base_link origin: dX -22.75 mm, dY 0, dZ 61.25 mm; 19.95 mm behind the window ring
camera.camera_link_origin: Camera point on the window axis
camera.axes: camera_link shares the base/flange and EEF axes (+Z optical axis = tool axis, +Y left finger, +X toward the off-axis fingers); optical link rpy [0, 0, -pi/2] (REP-103: +Z optical axis, +X image right, +Y image down toward the fingers)
camera.intrinsics: Per-device fisheye intrinsics are stored in the gripper firmware (TacCap-Gripper SDK)

urdf_frames.master_correspondence: Master <side>_follower_link == taccap_base_link: EEF, fingertips, camera and hinge axis lines agree within 0.1 mm
